test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 1
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that arranges the given sentences in the correct sequence The first sentence is in the correct position.**

A. Mrs Salmon who lived at 15, Northwood Street had been unable to sleep.

B. He had a hammer in his hand and had just come out of her house.

C. But when she went to the window she saw Adams standing on the steps of Mrs Parker’s house.

D. She heard a door click shut and thought it was her own gate.
solution:
The correct answer is option 4) i.e. "ADCB." 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• In the abovementioned paragraph, there is a chronological sequence of the sentences.
 
• Sentence A is the first sentence as it begins with the noun 'Mrs Salmon' and mentions she lived at Northwood street and could not sleep at night. 
 
• Sentence D is the second sentence as it begins with the pronoun 'she' as Mrs Salmon was a female person and mentions she heard the sound of shutting doors. Thus it establishes a relation with the previous sentence.
 
• Sentence C is the third sentence as it begins with the conjunction 'but' and creates a contrary situation. Here Mrs Salmon saw there was nobody at her gate but Adam was standing at Mrs Parker's gate.
 
• The only option that shows such an arrangement is Option 4.
 
• Sentence B is the last sentence as it begins with the pronoun 'he' because Adams was a male person and establishes a relation with the previous sentence.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is Option 4.

 

The correct order is:__ 

A. Mrs Salmon who lived at 15, Northwood Street had been unable to sleep.

D. She heard a door click shut and thought it was her own gate.

C. But when she went to the window she saw Adams standing on the steps of Mrs Parker’s house.

B. He had a hammer in his hand and had just come out of her house.
